channel.title: Capital goods & infra · Market Pressure Map
channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Capital goods & infra in Indian markets. Today: tailwind (+2.1).

item.title: [+1] World Bank cuts global growth forecast to 2.5%; India remains fastest-growing major economy
item.description:
Signal: stronger Indian growth data (India). 5 reports from BW Businessworld, DD News, StoryBoard 18 and 2 more. Related: “India Services PMI Hits Three-month High On Stronger Domestic Demand”. New in the last 24 hours.

Capital goods & infra: mild tailwind (+1) — Orders and capex firm

Why it matters: Better activity data points to firmer demand, orders and credit growth, supporting earnings across cyclical sectors.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +2, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks

item.title: [+1] RBI Governor on Impact of a Failed India-US Trade Deal
item.description:
Signal: trade deal or tariff relief for India (India). 8 reports from Kalkine India, DD News, Firstpost and 5 more. Related: “US and India join 14-economy pact to tackle global manufacturing overcapacity”. Turn: earlier readings (5 Oct) pointed the other way.

Capital goods & infra: mild tailwind (+1) — Engineering exports gain access

Why it matters: Lower tariffs or a trade deal open markets for Indian exporters and attract investment into export manufacturing.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1, Rupee +1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months

item.title: [+1] Zinc Falls As Stronger Dollar And Fed Rate Hike Signals Weigh On Market Sentiment By Kedia Advisory
item.description:
Signal: lower metal prices. 2 reports from Investing.com India, Shanghai Metals Market. Related: “[SMM Analysis] India's ADC 12 Prices Drop as LME Aluminium Corrects and Japanese Demand Soft”. Mixed: 2 reports point the other way. Ongoing: also reported on 1 of the previous 7 days (first 4 Oct).

Capital goods & infra: mild tailwind (+1) — Input costs ease

Why it matters: Falling metal prices cut Indian producers' realisations, often on weak Chinese demand, while easing input costs for manufacturers.

Confidence: low · horizon: weeks
